title: Expenses; rules.
bodyText:
(a) The department of health shall bear all expenses of travel and other necessary expenses incurred under sections 326-1 to 326-14 and may adopt all rules and forms and perform all acts necessary and proper for carrying out their provisions.

(b) Expenses related to patients shall be tracked separately from nonpatient costs, whenever appropriate and possible.

annotations.heading: Note
annotations.text: Sections 326-6 to 326-10, 326-12, and 326-14 referred to in text are repealed.

bodyHtml:
§326-13  Expenses; rules.  (a)  The department of health shall bear all expenses of travel and other necessary expenses incurred under sections 326-1 to 326-14 and may adopt all rules and forms and perform all acts necessary and proper for carrying out their provisions.

     (b)  Expenses related to patients shall be tracked separately from nonpatient costs, whenever appropriate and possible. [L 1909, c 81, §8; RL 1925, §1190; RL 1935, §1152; RL 1945, §2414; RL 1955, §50-15; am L Sp 1959 2d, c 1, §19; HRS §326-13; am L 2004, c 232, §3]

 

Note

 

  Sections 326-6 to 326-10, 326-12, and 326-14 referred to in text are repealed.

 

Cross References

 

  Rulemaking, see chapter 91.
